clips.title: The story
paras: In the Barrens, the Filled Brown Waterskin carries fresh water from the pond below Brine's hut. Aspiring shaman bring it to her to begin brewing sapta, used to commune with water spirits.

The pond beneath Brine's hut is a rare source of fresh water in the Barrens. Nearby quilboar fight fiercely over it, and a novice shaman sees how scarce water can drive creatures to defend what sustains them.
